answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The sparrow edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 178 clones produces a signature the mesa analysis flags immediately. Anyone must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the wharf settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 31 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
